title: Hearted
summary: HE'ARTED, adjective Taken to heart. [Not used.] 1. Composed of hearts. [Not used.] 2. Laid up in the heart. This word is chiefly used in composition, as hard-hearted, faint-hearted, stout-hearted, etc
